description: Two deterministic gates. Before git push: TruffleHog on the commits being pushed. Before a pull request (gh pr create, a gh api call to pulls, a GraphQL createPullRequest, or a GitHub MCP create_pull_request tool): TruffleHog on the branch, then a claude-security scan of HEAD must exist, or Claude is told to run the pre-pr-security skill first. The script runs on every Bash call and exits at once when the command's text has no push or PR creation; it fails closed, so text that only mentions one also triggers the gate.
